errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.body: We couldn't complete that action. Reloading the page usually resolves it.

notYourTurn.title: It's not your turn to sign yet
notYourTurn.body: The sender asked for this document to be signed in order. Someone ahead of you still needs to sign first.
notYourTurn.nothingToDo: There is nothing you need to do right now. We'll email you a signing link as soon as it's your turn.

loading.title: Opening your document…
loading.body: One moment while we set up your signing session.

invalid.title: This signing link is invalid
invalid.body: The link appears to be malformed. Ask the sender to send a fresh link to your email.

burned.title: This signing link has already been used
burned.body: If you still need to sign, ask the sender to resend the invite — we'll issue a new link.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this signing request
notFound.body: Double-check the link in your email, or ask the sender to resend it.

notYourTurn.title: It's not your turn to sign yet
notYourTurn.body: We'll email you a signing link as soon as it's your turn.

rateLimit.title: Too many attempts
rateLimit.body: Please wait a moment and try the link again.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: We couldn't open this document right now. Try again, or ask the sender for a fresh link.

declined.headingWrongRecipient: Thanks — we marked this link as the wrong recipient.
declined.bodyWrongRecipient: {{clause}} They can send a fresh link to the right person.
declined.final: This decision is final. The sender has been notified.

done.heading: Signed.
done.body: Your signature has been recorded. When everyone has signed, we'll email you a link to the sealed PDF.
done.sealingHint: We're finalizing the seal. This usually takes a few seconds.
done.saveTitle: Create your free Seald account to save this.
done.saveBody: Save this document, request signatures from others, and access your full signing history.
done.errorInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.

prep.subhero: Confirm your details below and we'll walk you through each field.
prep.declineConfirm: Decline this signing request? The sender will be notified and the document will remain unsigned.
prep.notMeTitle: Are you not the intended recipient?
prep.notMeBody: We'll let the sender know to send a fresh link to the right person. This is recorded in the audit trail and cannot be undone.
prep.errorAccept: We could not record your acceptance. Please try again.
prep.errorDecline: We could not decline right now. Please try again.
prep.errorWithdraw: We could not record your withdrawal right now. Please try again.

fill.optionalBodyOne: You have {{count}} optional field blank. Continue to review or fill them now?
fill.optionalBodyMany: You have {{count}} optional fields blank. Continue to review or fill them now?
fill.errorCheckbox: Could not save that change. Please try again.
fill.errorField: Could not save that field. Please try again.
fill.errorSignature: Could not apply your signature. Please try again.
fill.errorSignatureSave: Could not save your signature. Please try again.
fill.signatureTooLarge: That signature image is too large (max 512 KB). Please try a smaller image.
fill.declineConfirm: Decline this signing request? The sender will be notified and the document will remain unsigned.

fillError.rangeMin: Enter a number of at least {{min}}.
fillError.rangeMax: Enter a number of at most {{max}}.
fillError.rangeGeneric: That number is out of range.
fillError.notInOptions: Choose one of the listed options.
fillError.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
fillError.readOnly: This field is read-only and cannot be changed.

review.heading: Everything look right?
review.helper: Once everyone has signed, we seal the document and email each signer a link to it.
review.codeTitle: Enter a new emailed code to finish signing
review.errorSubmit: We could not submit right now. Please try again.
review.errorField: We could not update this field. Please try again.
review.errorSignature: We could not update this signature. Please try again.
review.errorWithdraw: We could not record your withdrawal right now. Please try again.

accessCode.title: Enter your emailed code
accessCode.leadSent: We emailed a one-time code to <email>{{email}}</email>. Enter the 6 digits below.
accessCode.leadWillSend: We will email a one-time code to <email>{{email}}</email>.
accessCode.purposeAction: The sender asked for a fresh code before you sign.
accessCode.purposeAccess: The sender asked for a code before you can open this document.
accessCode.hint: The code has {{digits}} digits and works for {{minutes}} minutes.

error.locked: Too many incorrect codes. This code no longer works, and after {{maxAttempts}} tries a new one is needed. Send a new code to try again.
error.expired: This code has expired. Send a new code to continue.
error.notRequested: There is no active code. Send a new code, then enter it here.
error.invalid: That code is not right. Check the email and enter the 6 digits again.
error.rateLimited: Too many codes were requested. Try again in {{wait}}.
error.cooldown: A code was just sent. Check your email, or wait to request another one.
error.unavailable: Emailed codes are not available right now. Try again later, or ask the sender.
error.session: This page timed out. Open the signing link in your email again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
